legal.in_english: This part is in English because its translation has not yet been checked by a person.
language.browser: As their browser asks, or English
editor.language.label: Language
editor.language.hint: What we show this person is in this language where it has been translated and checked, and in English where it has not. Your subject, message and documents are never translated: they stay as you wrote them.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.label: New recipients start in
settings.language.hint: Whoever sends can change it for each person, under More next to their name. Your subject, message and documents are never translated: they stay as you wrote them.
settings.security.title: Security record
settings.security.admins_only: Only the owner and admins of this account can see its security record. Ask one of them if you need something from it.
settings.security.load_failed: We could not load the security record just now. Reload the page to try again.
settings.security.nothing_changed: Something went wrong, so nothing was changed. Try again.
settings.security.download_failed: The download did not work, so no file was saved. Try again, or choose fewer days.
settings.security.what: It lists who signed in or failed to, and who changed what: logins, the team, API keys, webhooks, exports, deleted envelopes and settings. It never holds a password, code, key or anything from a document.
settings.security.chain_broken: A line of this record (number {seq}) does not match its fingerprint, so the record was changed outside the app. Tell the people who run this server.
settings.security.download_hint: The download has the lines shown here, with every filter. In it, people are named by their id, unless names and email addresses are switched on below.
settings.security.none: Nothing has been written yet. Lines start with the first sign-in or change from now on.
settings.security.none_filtered: Nothing matches these filters. Choose other days or Everything.
settings.security.alerts_what: Each alert emails every owner and admin of this account, at most once an hour. Switching one off is emailed to the other admins, and the events are still written here.
settings.security.alert_off: Switched off: {alert}. The other admins were told by email.
settings.security.siem_title: Send it to your security system
settings.security.pull: A security system can pull every line in order with an API key with the admin scope (Settings, API and webhooks). Keep the next_after of each answer and ask again with it:
settings.security.webhook_what: Or have each line posted as it is written, as the webhook event security.event. A webhook for every event does not get these: add one here for them.
settings.security.webhook_removed: The webhook to {host} was removed. It gets nothing more.
settings.security.webhook_added: Added. Its signing secret is under Settings, API and webhooks.
settings.security.webhook_label: Address of the webhook for the security record
settings.security.webhook_secret: Check each delivery with its signing secret, which is listed under Settings, API and webhooks.
settings.security.emails: Include names and email addresses when the record leaves GrowSigning
settings.security.emails_hint: Off: the download, the API, the webhook and the export name people by their id only. On: also by their name and email address as they are now. The record itself never stores them.
settings.security.emails_on: Names and email addresses are now included when the record leaves GrowSigning.
settings.security.emails_off: People are now named by their id only when the record leaves GrowSigning.
sign.purged.title: The sender deleted this document
sign.purged.body: It is no longer kept here, so this link cannot open it. If you need a copy, use the one you were emailed or downloaded, or ask the sender.
sign.purged.ask: The sender decides how long their documents are kept, so questions about this one are for them. For anything else, use the help page.
customfields.title: Custom fields
customfields.intro: Your account's own references, such as a case number, a cost centre, a grant or a ward. Whoever sends fills them in on the last step of the editor, and you can find, filter and export envelopes by them. They are never shown on the signing page. The ones printed on the certificate are on the copy everyone gets once the envelope is completed.
customfields.admins_only: Only the owner and admins can add, change or delete them.
customfields.load_failed: We could not load the custom fields just now. Reload the page to try again.
customfields.kind_list_n: {count, plural, one {A list of # choice} other {A list of # choices}}
customfields.full: This account has {max} custom fields, the most it can have. Delete one to add another.
customfields.past: Envelopes sent before a field was deleted keep its value, and the list of envelopes can still be filtered by it: {names}.
customfields.name: Name
customfields.kind_list_choice: One of a list of choices
customfields.choices_hint: Up to {max} choices, each up to 100 characters.
customfields.required_hint: An envelope without a value is not sent, and the sender is told what to fill in. A public form needs the value in its template, because its visitors cannot fill custom fields in.
customfields.cert_choice: Print on the certificate of completion
customfields.cert_hint: Everyone on the envelope gets the certificate with their copy, so print only what they may read.
customfields.change_hint: A change applies to drafts and templates. Envelopes that were sent keep the name and value they went out with.
customfields.added: Added. {name} is on the last step of the editor from now on.
customfields.changed: Saved. {name} is changed for drafts and templates.
customfields.deleted: {name} is deleted. {drafts, plural, =0 {No draft or template had a value for it.} one {One draft or template lost its value.} other {# drafts and templates lost their value.}} {sent, plural, =0 {No envelope that was sent had one.} one {One envelope that was sent keeps its value.} other {# envelopes that were sent keep their value.}}
customfields.delete_body: Drafts and templates lose their value for it. Envelopes that were sent keep theirs, with their certificate as it is, and you can still find, filter and export them by it.
customfields.offline: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again. Nothing was changed.
customfields.taken: There is already a custom field called {name}. Give this one another name.
customfields.need_choice: A list needs at least one choice. Type the choices, one on each line.
customfields.too_many_choices: A list can offer up to {max} choices, and this one has {count}.
customfields.choice_twice: {choice} is in the list twice. Give each choice once.
customfields.step.title: Details for your records
customfields.step.intro: Your account's own fields, such as a case number. They are not shown on the signing page. The ones printed on the certificate are on the copy everyone gets once it is completed.
customfields.step.intro_template: Every envelope made from this template starts with these values, and a public form uses them as they are. In a bulk send, a column named like a field fills it for that row.
customfields.step.intro_sent: This envelope is out. A change here is saved on its own, with a line in its audit trail, and nobody is asked to sign again.
customfields.step.kept: Kept from when this was sent, under names the account no longer has:
customfields.step.missing: {count, plural, one {Fill in {names} before sending: your account requires it.} other {Fill in {names} before sending: your account requires them.}}
customfields.step.save_sent_hint: Save details turns on once you change a value.
customfields.step.saved_sent: Saved. The change is in the audit trail.
customfields.filter.exact: Finds the envelopes whose value is exactly this, in capitals or not. Leave it empty to find every envelope that has a value.
customfields.filter.column: Show a custom field as a column
